en: A black-and-white postcard featuring a large historical complex on a hill. The image shows a prominent building with tall Gothic spires (a cathedral) alongside a castle-like structure. The architecture is distinctly European, with a mixture of fortified and ecclesiastical elements. The lower part of the image shows smaller houses and vegetation. There is printed text at the bottom left.
